text: Recursive Evaluation Routine A tree evaluator mirrors the syntax of the program. def eval_tree(node, state): if node.is_leaf(): if node.value in state: return state[node.value] return float(node.value) vals = [eval_tree(ch, state) for ch in node.children] if node.value == "+": return vals[0] + vals[1] if node.value == "-": return vals[0] - vals[1] if node.value == "x*": return vals[0] * vals[1] The same recursive pattern extends naturally to protected division, trigonometric nodes, and conditional nodes.
